title: Endpoint Exposure Classifier
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Decide, for six configurations of a local model endpoint, whether a stated party can reach it.

educational.topic: Inference Servers and Local API Endpoints
learningObjectives: The learner will distinguish, for 6 configurations of a local endpoint, whether a stated party can reach it, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Cases 2 and 3 have the same binding and the same laptop, and opposite answers. State what differs.
commonMisconceptions: Any machine on the same network can reach a localhost-bound server.
A port forward needs the server to listen on a network address.
Binding to every interface exposes the server to the whole internet regardless of the router.
Tailscale Serve opens the server to everyone.
assessmentOpportunities: Mastery is 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt.
